title: Burgess Lowman CPAs
description: bllcpas.com Burgess Lowman Lay CPAs is an American accounting firm based in Wilmington, North Carolina, with over 50 years of experience serving small and medium businesses, nonprofits and individuals. With approximately 20 to 30 professionals, it provides tax preparation and planning, bookkeeping, audits, reviews and business advisory services. Its client base includes manufacturing, real estate, healthcare, nonprofit organizations and high-net-worth individuals across southeastern North Carolina. Specialized offerings include employee benefit plan audits, single audits, IRS representation, business valuation and outsourced CFO services. The firm operates under the motto More Than Just Numbers, emphasizing strategic advisory beyond traditional compliance. Founded by its three named partners Burgess, Lowman and Lowman, it has built a deep reputation in the Wilmington business community.
